channels:
  - conda-forge
  - bioconda
dependencies:
  - pip=25.3
  - python=3.11.13
  - tifffile=2025.6.11
  - conda-forge::ome-types=0.6.1
  - scikit-image=0.25.2
  - pandas=2.2.2
  - conda-forge::matplotlib=3.10.8
  - conda-forge::imagecodecs=2026.3.6
  - lxml=6.0.2
  - pip:
      - itk-elastix==0.23.0
      - openslide-python==1.4.2
      - openslide-bin==4.0.0.8
      - rami2d==1.0.1

// Copyright (c) the nf-core community under an open-source MIT license.
// See https://github.com/nf-core/modules for full license, file patching instructions and upstream contributing.

process RAMI2D_REGISTER {
    tag "$meta.id"
    label 'process_single'

    conda "${moduleDir}/environment.yml"
    container "${ workflow.containerEngine == 'singularity' && !task.ext.singularity_pull_docker_container ?
        'https://community-cr-prod.seqera.io/docker/registry/v2/blobs/sha256/cd/cde38bd19f190e920f5f99178fd6802f841e5e52f596e2efe13f95c733637850/data':
        'community.wave.seqera.io/library/pip_python_tifffile_ome-types_pruned:d3b5c8c723a6348d' }"

    input:
    tuple val(meta), path(fixed_img), path(moving_img)
    tuple val(meta2), path(markers)
    val(ifix)
    val(imov)
    val(mpp_fix)
    val(mpp_mov)
    val(mpp_reg)

    output:
    tuple val(meta), path("${prefix}/*.ome.tif"), emit: registered_image
    tuple val(meta), path("${prefix}/qc")       , emit: qc_dir
    tuple val("${task.process}"), val('rami2d') , eval('rami2d-register -v | sed "s/rami2d-register //"'), emit: versions_rami2d, topic: versions

    when:
    task.ext.when == null || task.ext.when

    script:
    def args = task.ext.args ?: ''
    prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}"
    def markers_arg = markers ? "-m ${markers}" : ""
    """
    export MPLCONFIGDIR=./matplotlib_cache
    export XDG_CACHE_HOME=./.cache
    export FONTCONFIG_PATH=./.cache/fontconfig

    mkdir -p $prefix

    rami2d-register \\
        -fix $fixed_img \\
        -mov $moving_img \\
        -ifix $ifix \\
        -imov $imov \\
        -mpp-fix $mpp_fix \\
        -mpp-mov $mpp_mov \\
        -mpp-reg $mpp_reg \\
        -o $prefix \\
        $markers_arg \\
        $args
    """

    stub:
    prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}"

    """
    mkdir -p $prefix/qc/refchns
    mkdir -p $prefix/qc/keypoints
    mkdir -p $prefix/qc/fullres_trf

    touch ${prefix}/${moving_img.baseName}_registered.ome.tif
    touch ${prefix}/qc/refchns/elastix.log
    touch ${prefix}/qc/fullres_trf/transform.txt
    """
}

---
name: "nf-core/rami2d/register"
description: "offers 3 pre-defined registration schemes 1) Rigid, 2) Rigid+Affine\
  \ 3) Rigid+Affine+Bsplines, each of them providing more geometrical adaptability\
  \ and thus more control in the final outcome."
keywords:
- "registration"
- "imaging"
- "multiplex"
- "spatial"
tools:
- rami2d:
    description: "Robust Alignment of Multichannel Images in 2D"
    homepage: "https://pypi.org/project/rami2d/"
    documentation: "https://github.com/VictorDidier/RAMI2D"
    tool_dev_url: "https://github.com/VictorDidier/RAMI2D"
    licence:
    - "BSD-3-Clause"
    identifier: ""
input:
- - meta:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing fixed image sample information\ne.g. [ id:'sample1'\
        \ ]\n"
  - fixed_img:
      type: "file"
      description: "Absolute path of the image stack containing the fixed image"
      pattern: "*.{tif,tiff,ome.tif,ome.tiff,svs,avs,vms,dcm,vmus,ndpi,scn,mrxs,svslide,bif,czi}"
      ontologies: []
  - moving_img:
      type: "file"
      description: "Absolute path of the image stack containing the moving image"
      pattern: "*.{tif,tiff,ome.tif,ome.tiff,svs,avs,vms,dcm,vmus,ndpi,scn,mrxs,svslide,bif,czi}"
      ontologies: []
- - meta2:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing metadata information for the markers file\n\
        e.g. [ id:'markers' ]\n"
  - markers:
      type: "file"
      description: "Path to a csv file with a column named marker_name, each row is\
        \ the name of the channel in the ome metadata of the output image"
      pattern: "*.csv"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3752"
- ifix:
    type: "string"
    description: "Integer or string h,e,d. 0-based index of channel to be used for\
      \ registration. If string it converts your H&E into Hematoxylin, Eosin or DAB.\
      \ fixed image stack"
- imov:
    type: "string"
    description: "Integer or string h,e,d. 0-based index of channel to be used for\
      \ registration. If string it converts your H&E into Hematoxylin, Eosin or DAB.\
      \ moving image stack"
- mpp_fix:
    type: "float"
    description: "Pixel size of the fixed image in micrometers"
- mpp_mov:
    type: "float"
    description: "Pixel size of the moving image in micrometers"
- mpp_reg:
    type: "float"
    description: "Image resolution in micrometers to be used for applying the registration\
      \ scheme"
output:
  registered_image:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. [ id:'sample1'\
          \ ]\n"
    - ${prefix}/*.ome.tif:
        type: "file"
        description: "Registered output image in pyramidal OME TIFF format"
        pattern: "*.ome.tif"
        ontologies: []
  qc_dir:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. [ id:'sample1'\
          \ ]\n"
    - ${prefix}/qc:
        type: "directory"
        description: "Directory containing QC outputs including subdirectories refchns,\
          \ keypoints and fullres transformations"
        pattern: "qc"
  versions_rami2d:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "Name of the task process"
    - rami2d:
        type: "string"
        description: "Name of the tool"
    - rami2d-register -v | sed "s/rami2d-register //":
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
topics:
  versions:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "Name of the task process"
    - rami2d:
        type: "string"
        description: "Name of the tool"
    - rami2d-register -v | sed "s/rami2d-register //":
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
authors:
- "@kubranarci"
maintainers:
- "@kubranarci"
version: "0.0.0-6d1763b"
license: "MIT License"
